recipe.title: Poha Recipe | Maharastrian Aloo Kanda Pohe

ingredients.name: potato
ingredients.prep_note: chopped, fried till golden and crisp

steps.text: Place a sieve in a bowl and rinse 2½ cups of poha till the water runs clean. Do not soak the poha.
steps.label: Rinse poha

steps.text: Keep the poha aside for 10 minutes, and it will become non-sticky and soft.
steps.label: Soften poha
steps.attention_cue: Keep the poha aside for 10 minutes
steps.doneness_cue: it will become non-sticky and soft

steps.text: In a wok heat 2 tbsp oil and fry 2 tbsp peanut till they turn crunchy. Keep aside.
steps.label: Fry peanuts

steps.text: Also, fry 1 potato till it turns golden and crisp. Keep aside.
steps.label: Fry potato
steps.doneness_cue: till it turns golden and crisp

steps.text: In the same oil, add ½ tsp mustard, ½ tsp cumin, pinch hing, 2 chilli, 1 inch ginger, few curry leaves and splutter the tempering.
steps.label: Temper spices

steps.text: Add 1 onion, and saute till the onions softens.
steps.label: Saute onions

steps.text: Now add ½ tsp turmeric, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp sugar and saute till the spices turn aromatic.
steps.label: Cook spices

steps.text: Further add fried peanut and potato and mix well.
steps.label: Add fried items

steps.text: Now add in poha and mix gently.
steps.label: Mix poha

steps.text: Also add ½ lemon and 2 tbsp coriander. Mix gently.
steps.label: Finish seasoning

steps.text: Cover and simmer for 5 minutes, or until the poha is cooked fully.
steps.label: Simmer covered
steps.doneness_cue: until the poha is cooked fully

steps.text: Finally, enjoy Kanda Poha Recipe with chivda.
steps.label: Serve

notes: Method and ingredients taken from linked blog schema.org Recipe JSON-LD. Durations for non-stated steps are estimates; stated durations were used verbatim for the 10-minute rest and 5-minute simmer. 'poha' ingredient line included prep note 'rinsed, do not soak' derived from the step text.
